card.name: Final zero in round dose numbers
card.fires_on: The last digit 0 closing a multi-digit dose or count such as 450, 300 or 900, and the word months after 48 in monitoring schedules. It appears in dosing and follow-up text.

modes.label: Trailing zero of a number
modes.description: The digit 0 ending a three- or four-digit amount, usually before mg.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage: 45<<0>> mg orally once daily with food.

modes.label: Months after 48
modes.description: The word months after the number 48 in a follow-up period after the last infusion.
modes.example: at monthly intervals thereafter until 48<< months>> after the last infusion

card.plain: It fires on the final zero of round dose numbers like 450 mg, and on 'months' in '48 months after the last infusion'.
